name: bdxy-correlation-us-rates-1min
description: BMO reproduction at 1Min: session_window(4pm ET snap) → downsample(1D) → rolling_corr with FRED yields. Synthetic BDXY from 12 FX pairs.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BMO REPRODUCTION: SYNTHETIC BDXY CORRELATION TO US MARKET VARIABLES
# =============================================================================
# Pipeline: 1Min FX data → session_window(4pm ET snap) → downsample(1D) → rolling_corr
# 1Min global_timeframe (ENG-678 downsample fix applied)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()

# =============================================================================
# FX SESSION WINDOWS: 4PM ET SNAP (15:55-16:00 window)
# =============================================================================

# --- EUR (primary asset) ---
eur_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='15:55', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'))(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)
eur_daily = downsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ffill(eur_sw.close))
ret_eur = returns(period=1)(eur_daily)

# --- JPY ---
jpy_src = fx_pairs(ticker='USDJPY')()
jpy_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='15:55', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'))(jpy_src.o, jpy_src.h, jpy_src.l, jpy_src.c)
jpy_daily = downsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ffill(jpy_sw.close))
ret_jpy = returns(period=1)(jpy_daily)

# --- CAD ---
cad_src = fx_pairs(ticker='USDCAD')()
cad_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='15:55', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'))(cad_src.o, cad_src.h, cad_src.l, cad_src.c)
cad_daily = downsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ffill(cad_sw.close))
ret_cad = returns(period=1)(cad_daily)

# --- GBP ---
gbp_src = fx_pairs(ticker='GBPUSD')()
gbp_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='15:55', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'))(gbp_src.o, gbp_src.h, gbp_src.l, gbp_src.c)
gbp_daily = downsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ffill(gbp_sw.close))
ret_gbp = returns(period=1)(gbp_daily)

# --- MXN ---
mxn_src = fx_pairs(ticker='USDMXN')()
mxn_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='15:55', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'))(mxn_src.o, mxn_src.h, mxn_src.l, mxn_src.c)
mxn_daily = downsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ffill(mxn_sw.close))
ret_mxn = returns(period=1)(mxn_daily)

# --- AUD ---
aud_src = fx_pairs(ticker='AUDUSD')()
aud_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='15:55', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'))(aud_src.o, aud_src.h, aud_src.l, aud_src.c)
aud_daily = downsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ffill(aud_sw.close))
ret_aud = returns(period=1)(aud_daily)

# --- CHF ---
chf_src = fx_pairs(ticker='USDCHF')()
chf_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='15:55', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'))(chf_src.o, chf_src.h, chf_src.l, chf_src.c)
chf_daily = downsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ffill(chf_sw.close))
ret_chf = returns(period=1)(chf_daily)

# --- KRW ---
krw_src = fx_pairs(ticker='USDKRW')()
krw_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='15:55', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'))(krw_src.o, krw_src.h, krw_src.l, krw_src.c)
krw_daily = downsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ffill(krw_sw.close))
ret_krw = returns(period=1)(krw_daily)

# --- CNH ---
cnh_src = fx_pairs(ticker='USDCNH')()
cnh_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='15:55', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'))(cnh_src.o, cnh_src.h, cnh_src.l, cnh_src.c)
cnh_daily = downsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ffill(cnh_sw.close))
ret_cnh = returns(period=1)(cnh_daily)

# --- INR ---
inr_src = fx_pairs(ticker='USDINR')()
inr_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='15:55', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'))(inr_src.o, inr_src.h, inr_src.l, inr_src.c)
inr_daily = downsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ffill(inr_sw.close))
ret_inr = returns(period=1)(inr_daily)

# --- BRL ---
brl_src = fx_pairs(ticker='USDBRL')()
brl_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='15:55', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'))(brl_src.o, brl_src.h, brl_src.l, brl_src.c)
brl_daily = downsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ffill(brl_sw.close))
ret_brl = returns(period=1)(brl_daily)

# --- TWD ---
twd_src = fx_pairs(ticker='USDTWD')()
twd_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='15:55', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'))(twd_src.o, twd_src.h, twd_src.l, twd_src.c)
twd_daily = downsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ffill(twd_sw.close))
ret_twd = returns(period=1)(twd_daily)

# =============================================================================
# SYNTHETIC BDXY DAILY RETURN (weighted, sign-adjusted)
# =============================================================================

bdxy_ret = (0.315 * (0.0 - ret_eur)) + (0.179 * ret_jpy) + (0.114 * ret_cad) + (0.085 * (0.0 - ret_gbp)) + (0.074 * ret_mxn) + (0.052 * (0.0 - ret_aud)) + (0.036 * ret_chf) + (0.039 * ret_krw) + (0.035 * ret_cnh) + (0.029 * ret_inr) + (0.022 * ret_brl) + (0.020 * ret_twd)

# =============================================================================
# US MARKET VARIABLES
# =============================================================================

t2y_src = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.Treasury2Y)()
t2y = ffill_day(t2y_src.result)
t2y_daily = downsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(t2y)

t10y_src = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.Treasury10Y)()
t10y = ffill_day(t10y_src.result)
t10y_daily = downsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(t10y)

spread_2s10s = t10y_daily - t2y_daily

spy_src = reference_stocks(ticker='SPY')()
spy_sw = session_window(session=Session(start='15:55', end='16:00', tz='America/New_York'))(spy_src.o, spy_src.h, spy_src.l, spy_src.c)
spy_daily = downsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(ffill(spy_sw.close))

ret_spy = returns(period=1)(spy_daily)
chg_t2y = t2y_daily - (t2y_daily >> 1)
chg_t10y = t10y_daily - (t10y_daily >> 1)
chg_2s10s = spread_2s10s - (spread_2s10s >> 1)

# =============================================================================
# 3-MONTH ROLLING CORRELATIONS (63 trading days)
# =============================================================================

corr_bdxy_t2y = rolling_corr(window=63, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=bdxy_ret, y=chg_t2y)
corr_bdxy_t10y = rolling_corr(window=63, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=bdxy_ret, y=chg_t10y)
corr_bdxy_2s10s = rolling_corr(window=63, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=bdxy_ret, y=chg_2s10s)
corr_bdxy_spy = rolling_corr(window=63, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=bdxy_ret, y=ret_spy)

idx = index()()
idx_daily = downsample(target_timeframe=1D, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(idx)

# =============================================================================
# CHART
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='USD Reconnecting With Rates, Less Driven by Yield Curve (3m Rolling Corr)',
    category='USD Correlation Structure',
    y_axis_label='Rolling 63d Correlation',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='US 2Y Yield', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='US 10Y Yield', color=Color.Slate),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='US 2s10s Spread', color=Color.Gray),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SPX', color=Color.Red)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx_daily, corr_bdxy_t2y, corr_bdxy_t10y, corr_bdxy_2s10s, corr_bdxy_spy)

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Synthetic BDXY Correlation to US Market Variables (Latest)',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['63d Corr'],
        col_headers=['US 2Y', 'US 10Y', '2s10s', 'SPX'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Slate),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Gray),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, grid_color=Color.Red)
        ]
    ),
    category='USD Correlation Structure',
    order=1
)(corr_bdxy_t2y, corr_bdxy_t10y, corr_bdxy_2s10s, corr_bdxy_spy)
